layer_3_action.subject: Argentinosaurus
features: gargantuan, colossal mountains-sized barrel torso built with immense vertical depth
stout trunk-like pillar legs thicker than any other sauropod to visually emphasize massive weight distribution
deep, tall elephantine skull profile with a high nasal ridge, small rounded snout, and friendly closed mouth
thick, structural girder-like neck rising diagonally at a bold angle from the heavy shoulders
long, heavy-set tapering tail held completely clear of the ground to balance the front weight
smooth seamless matte clay-like skin with a deep slate-grey and dark olive mottled base color
